 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 6 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Things are about to pick up pace. Expect temperatures flying, stagnant situations gaining momentum and that feeling of ‘I’m done’ to feel a lot more pronounced. What has been brewing beneath the surface finally begins to see daylight. You can't hide anymore. You can't stay shut anymore. In fact, you are done with feeling like you are bearing the brunt of it all, for no solid reason. And Leo , this time, in a very grounded manner, you are really done. There is no shying away from saying things as you feel. And there definitely is no holding you back.
 Cosmic tip: Release what's in your heart to welcome what's entering your life.
